view.description: The reader's single page: feeds grouped under headings, each a collapsed disclosure showing feed title and URL, with errors and footer at the bottom.

regions.label: H1 title with owl emoji '🦉 Bubo Reader'

Five category sections (Developer News, Blogs, Design, Reading & Misc, My GitHub Projects), each a stack of collapsible <details> rows: feed title + grey feed URL; expanding reveals dated headline links
'Errors' heading, explanatory sentence and bullet list of feeds that failed to fetch/parse
Horizontal rule, last-updated timestamp, 'Powered by' credits and sponsor link

evidence.note: Native <details>/<summary> disclosure rows with triangle marker; clicking the summary reveals the feed's items in place (verified live)

patterns.rationale: Content is aggregated RSS items in reverse-chronological order (headline density), but grouped per source behind disclosures rather than a single merged stream; unclear if this counts as a feed.

evidence.note: Expanded live: list of '11/15/2026 - <headline link>' items, newest first

evidence.quote: There were errors trying to parse these feeds:

structure.layout: single-column unstyled HTML document: H1, category H2 sections with stacked disclosure rows, errors list, footer; left-aligned at 8px default body margin

aesthetics.typography: system-ui throughout (browser-default styling): bold headings, regular 18px body/summary text; feed URLs in grey
aesthetics.typeScale: H1 36px bold, H2 27px bold, everything else 18px regular — three steps, contrast via size/weight only

notes: Essentially unstyled HTML (default browser link blue #0000ee, default 8px margin, native <details> disclosure triangles). Only custom styling is 18px system-ui font and #aaaaaa grey for the parenthesised feed URLs. Owl emoji as the only visual brand element. Expanded items are 'M/D/YYYY - <underlined link>' bullets. An 'Errors' section transparently lists failed feeds with raw error messages; footer shows 'Last updated' build timestamp, hinting at a static-site generator.
